decisions.reason: The DPA management tool sits close to the firm's compliance know-how and agency focus, and early customer praise for its roughly 200 agency templates gives interpretable positive feedback that in-house R&D can build on.

The hosting management platform extends the firm's integrated tooling and containerized architecture, is featured on the home page as a core offer, and fits the strategic direction of agency-focused platform features.
A configurable managed hosting plan draws directly on the firm's owned infrastructure and service teams, so the firm can readily interpret its results and refine it at low added cost.
